persianMeaning: ولونگانگ؛ شهری در جنوب شرقی استرالیا
englishDefinition: Wollongong is the name of a coastal city in New South Wales that learners meet on maps and in news reports.
example: Wollongong has grown rapidly since the port was expanded.
examplePersian: ولونگانگ از زمان گسترش بندر به‌سرعت رشد کرده است.
commonMistakes: This card is only about the city name; it carries no general meaning of its own.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The hard material taken from the trunk and branches of a tree and used to make furniture or to burn as fuel.
example: Plastic has replaced wood in many school desks.
examplePersian: پلاستیک جای چوب را در بسیاری از میزهای مدرسه گرفته است.
commonMistakes: Wood is the material; woods is a place covered with trees.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An area of land covered with a large number of growing trees, often used in literary description.
example: Dense woods still cover the hills north of the town.
examplePersian: جنگل انبوه هنوز تپه‌های شمال شهر را پوشانده است.
commonMistakes: Woods is a place covered with trees; wood is the material itself.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: نحوه بیان؛ انتخاب و ترتیب کلمات
englishDefinition: The exact words chosen to express an idea, together with the order in which they are arranged.
example: The wording of the notice led several applicants to withdraw.
examplePersian: نحوه بیان اطلاعیه باعث شد چند متقاضی انصراف دهند.
commonMistakes: Wording refers to the words and their arrangement, not only to the general meaning.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The separate written or spoken units of language that are combined to express an idea or a meaning.
example: The speakers use technical words that ordinary readers may not know.
examplePersian: گویندگان از واژه‌های تخصصی استفاده می‌کنند که خوانندگان عادی ممکن است آنها را ندانند.
commonMistakes: Words is the plural of the unit word; it is not another word for language as a system.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who is employed to do a particular job, whether in a factory, an office, or a hospital.
example: Most of the workers in the plant are paid by the hour.
examplePersian: بیشتر کارگران این کارخانه به‌ازای هر ساعت دستمزد می‌گیرند.
commonMistakes: A worker is any employed person; the word is not limited to manual labour.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Currently able to function or be used in the way it is intended, even if it is not yet perfect.
example: The museum has a working internet connection for visiting researchers.
examplePersian: موزه برای پژوهشگران بازدیدکننده اتصال اینترنتی فعالی دارد.
commonMistakes: Working as an adjective means able to function; the plural working conditions is a separate noun phrase.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The total amount of work that a person or a team has to complete within a given period.
example: A heavier workload has left the hospital short of nurses.
examplePersian: افزایش حجم کار بیمارستان را در کمبود پرستار گرفتار کرده است.
commonMistakes: A workload is the amount of work, not a schedule or a single task.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A short meeting or course in which people learn a practical skill by doing the activity themselves.
example: She runs a weekend workshop on how to write clearly.
examplePersian: او کارگاهی در آخر هفته درباره نحوه نوشتن روشن برگزار می‌کند.
commonMistakes: In academic English a workshop is a short practical course or meeting, not a physical place.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A series of short courses or meetings, usually held regularly, where people learn a practical skill by doing it.
example: The charity offers free workshops in digital skills for older residents.
examplePersian: این خیریه برای ساکنان مسن کارگاه‌های رایگان مهارت‌های دیجیتال برگزار می‌کند.
commonMistakes: The plural refers to several separate workshop events held over time.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Earth together with all the people, countries, and living things on it.
example: Rising sea levels threaten low-lying cities around the world.
examplePersian: بالا آمدن سطح دریا شهرهای کم‌ارتفاع سراسر جهان را تهدید می‌کند.
commonMistakes: World means the earth and its people; worldwide is the adjective for something spread across it.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The showing of deep respect for a god or goddess, especially in organised religious ceremonies.
example: Freedom of worship is protected by the country's constitution.
examplePersian: آزادی عبادت در قانون اساسی این کشور تضمین شده است.
commonMistakes: Worship is a noun here; worship God is a verb phrase and is not interchangeable with this card.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Important or useful enough to justify the time, money, or effort that it takes.
example: Nurses judged the new screening programme worthwhile despite its cost.
examplePersian: پرستاران برنامه جدید غربالگری را با وجود هزینه‌اش ارزشمند دانستند.
commonMistakes: The spelling is worthwhile, not worth while; it describes something worth the effort.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To cover something completely in paper, cloth, or plastic by folding the material closely around it.
example: Museum staff wrapped each sculpture in protective foam.
examplePersian: کارکنان موزه هر مجسمه را در فوم محافظتی پیچیدند.
commonMistakes: Wrap means to cover completely; the phrasal verb wrap up means to finish, not to cover.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: تاج گل؛ حلقه‌ای از برگ و گل
englishDefinition: A ring of leaves, flowers, or branches arranged in a circle and hung on a door or wall.
example: A green wreath hung above the doorway during the festival.
examplePersian: حلقه‌ای سبز از برگ در جشنواره بالای ورودی آویخته شده بود.
commonMistakes: The common spelling is wreath; wreathe is a related verb meaning to wind or cover.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A vehicle, ship, or building that has been badly damaged or completely destroyed.
example: The fishing boat was found as a complete wreck off the coast.
examplePersian: کشتی ماهیگیری به‌صورت آواری کامل در نزدیکی ساحل پیدا شد.
commonMistakes: A wreck is the damaged object itself; wreck used as a verb means to destroy completely.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A sudden, sharp pain caused by a muscle or joint being twisted or strained.
example: She complained of a sharp wrench in her lower back.
examplePersian: او از درد شدیدی در کمر خود شکایت داشت.
commonMistakes: This card uses the medical sense; the tool sense is a different meaning of the same noun.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: دست‌وپنجه نرم کردن با؛ مقابله کردن با
englishDefinition: To deal with a difficult problem or feeling that you cannot easily overcome or control.
example: Many small farms are still wrestling with rising feed costs.
examplePersian: بسیاری از مزارع کوچک هنوز با افزایش هزینه خوراک دام دست‌وپنجه نرم می‌کنند.
commonMistakes: Wrestle with means to struggle with a difficulty, not to take part in a sporting contest.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Extremely bad or unpleasant, and therefore making you feel pity for the person affected.
example: The report described the wretched conditions in the coastal settlement.
examplePersian: گزارش شرایط رقت‌انگیز در سکونتگاه ساحلی را توصیف کرد.
commonMistakes: Wretched is strongly negative and pitying; it does not simply mean unlucky.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A thin line or fold in the surface of the skin or of a piece of cloth.
example: The fabric has a deep wrinkle running across the sleeve.
examplePersian: روی آستین پارچه یک چین عمیق کشیده شده است.
commonMistakes: A wrinkle can also mean a small problem, but this card uses the physical fold in the chosen sense.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person whose main job is to write books, articles, or other texts.
example: Many freelance writers now earn more from online articles than from books.
examplePersian: بسیاری از نویسندگان مستقل اکنون از مقالات آنلاین بیش از کتاب درآمد دارند.
commonMistakes: A writer is the person; writing is the activity or the finished text.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The activity of putting ideas or facts into words on paper or on a screen.
example: Clear academic writing helps readers follow technical arguments.
examplePersian: نگارش دانشگاهی روشن به خوانندگان کمک می‌کند تا استدلال‌های فنی را دنبال کنند.
commonMistakes: Writing can also mean the finished text; this card uses the activity sense.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Made or shaped by hand, usually with great care and skill, especially out of metal.
example: The gate was wrought from iron in the seventeenth century.
examplePersian: این دروازه در قرن هفدهم از آهن ساخته شده بود.
commonMistakes: Wrought is the past participle of work and is normally placed before a material or craft noun.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A photograph of the inside of the body made with a special machine that uses rays.
example: The X-ray showed no sign of bone damage in her ankle.
examplePersian: عکس‌برداری با پرتو ایکس هیچ نشانه‌ای از آسیب استخوانی در مچ پای او نشان نداد.
commonMistakes: In medical usage take an X-ray is more natural than have an X-ray when referring to the photograph.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An area of ground next to a building that is open to the sky and usually walled or fenced.
example: The children played football in the yard after school.
examplePersian: کودکان پس از مدرسه در حیاط فوتبال بازی کردند.
commonMistakes: This card uses the outdoor-area sense; the unit of length is a different meaning of yard.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A long thin strand of wool, cotton, or other fibre, used for knitting or weaving.
example: Local women spin wool and sell the yarn at the market.
examplePersian: زنان محلی پشم را می‌ریسند و نخ آن را در بازار می‌فروشند.
commonMistakes: Yarn can also mean a long exaggerated story; this card uses the textile sense.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To open your mouth very wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored.
example: Listeners began to yawn during the long evening lecture.
examplePersian: شنوندان در طول سخنرانی طولانی شروع به خمیازه کشیدن کردند.
commonMistakes: Yawn is a verb here; the noun yawn is the act itself and is not interchangeable in a sentence.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To feel a strong and often sad wish for something or someone that you cannot have.
example: Exiles often yearn for the music and food of their childhood.
examplePersian: مهاجران اغلب دلتنگ موسیقی و غذای دوران کودکی خودشان هستند.
commonMistakes: Yearn is more emotionally intense than want; it normally takes for or to plus an infinitive.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Having the colour of the sun or of a lemon, somewhere between green and orange.
example: The map uses yellow lines to mark the proposed railway route.
examplePersian: نقشه برای نشان دادن مسیر پیشنهادی راه‌آهن از خطوط زرد استفاده می‌کند.
commonMistakes: This card uses the colour adjective; the noun yellow and the verb yellow are different uses.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The basic unit of money used in Japan, equal to one hundred sen.
example: The museum ticket costs 1500 yen.
examplePersian: قیمت بلیت موزه ۱۵۰۰ ین است.
commonMistakes: Yen is the Japanese currency unit; the unrelated English verb yen meaning to desire is a different word.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The amount of a crop or other product that a piece of land or a process produces.
example: Higher temperatures reduced the crop yield in several regions.
examplePersian: دمای بالاتر عملکرد محصول را در چند منطقه کاهش داد.
commonMistakes: Yield is also a verb meaning to produce or to give way; this card uses the noun agricultural sense.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An exercise practice that uses slow body positions, controlled breathing, and meditation to improve health.
example: A weekly yoga class helped many staff manage back pain.
examplePersian: کلاس هفتگی یوگا به بسیاری از کارکنان کمک کرد کمردردشان را کنترل کنند.
commonMistakes: Yoga can describe a modern exercise class or a wider philosophical tradition; this card uses the exercise sense.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A system of rule or control that keeps people subjected and takes away their freedom.
example: The novel describes the yoke of colonial rule over ordinary farmers.
examplePersian: رمان یوغ حاکمیت استعماری بر کشاورزان عادی را توصیف می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Yoke can also mean the frame that joins animals or the upper part of a garment; this card uses the figurative sense of oppression.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: خاندان یورک؛ شاخه‌ای از خاندان پلانتاژنت
englishDefinition: The royal house of England that held the throne from 1461 to 1485 and used a white rose as its emblem.
example: The House of York fought for the English crown during the Wars of the Roses.
examplePersian: خاندان یورک در جنگ‌های رزها برای تاج انگلستان جنگید.
commonMistakes: York is also a city in England; this card refers only to the medieval royal house.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A young person, especially a child or teenager, used in a friendly or informal way.
example: The programme gives local youngsters a chance to learn new skills.
examplePersian: این برنامه به جوانان محلی فرصتی برای آموختن مهارت‌های تازه می‌دهد.
commonMistakes: Youngster is an informal word for a young person; it is not limited to boys.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Young people in general, considered as one group within society.
example: Youth unemployment remains high in many rural regions.
examplePersian: بیکاری جوانان در بسیاری از مناطق روستایی همچنان بالاست.
commonMistakes: This card uses the collective sense of young people; youth as a life period is a different sense.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The number that means no quantity at all and that nothing can be added to without changing it.
example: The survey recorded zero deaths during the first three months.
examplePersian: این نظرسنجی در سه ماه نخست صفر مورد مرگ ثبت کرد.
commonMistakes: Zero is a number; zero in is a separate verb meaning to concentrate attention on something.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Energetic enthusiasm for doing something or for life in general.
example: She started the campaign with a zest that surprised her colleagues.
examplePersian: او کارزار را با شوری آغاز کرد که همکارانش را غافلگیر کرد.
commonMistakes: Zest can also mean a strong smell or flavour; this card uses the figurative enthusiasm sense.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A public place where wild animals are kept and shown so that the public can look at them.
example: The zoo now runs a breeding programme for endangered species.
examplePersian: باغ‌وحیوانات اکنون برای گونه‌های در خطر انقراض برنامه پرورش اجرا می‌کند.
commonMistakes: Zoo is a public place for displaying animals, not a word for every animal enclosure.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The scientific study of animals, including their bodies, behaviour, and relationships.
example: She studied zoology for three years before joining the field team.
examplePersian: او سه سال جانورشناسی خواند و سپس به تیم میدانی پیوست.
commonMistakes: Zoology studies animals; ecology studies the relationships between organisms and their environment.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0
